sources.label: Cherry Hills Country Club (Wikipedia)
supports: founded in 1922 to a William Flynn design and renovated by Tom Doak in 2008
hosted three U.S. Opens (1938, 1960 and 1978), two PGA Championships (1941 and 1985), the 2005 U.S. Women's Open, the 1993 U.S. Senior Open and the 2014 BMW Championship
championship 18 and a 9-hole par-3, and Glenmoor Country Club sits inside the Village as well

sources.label: Cherry Hills Village: Accessory and Recreational Structure Requirements, revised 23 May 2024 (PDF)
supports: Any structure that is a detached subordinate structure including, but not limited to, the following: ... Sports Courts
Separate permits and plans are required for the following: 1. Additions to existing structures... 4. Fences, walls/retaining walls, and earthen berms
A Phase III Drainage Report if adding more than 2500 square feet of impervious surface area

A Stormwater Management Plan (SWMP) or Grading, Erosion, and Sediment Control Plan (GESC) and a completed Stormwater Construction Permit Application if disturbing 1 acre or more and/or adjacent to a waterway or watercourse (floodplain)
